target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Responsible for enforcement of Ohio Building Codes. Already has online Customer Portal for permits and inspections. Digital blueprint submission and review tools would streamline permit processing, reduce paper handling, and improve 30-day plan review process.

actual_brand_research.mission: Enforce Ohio Building Codes, ensure health/safety/welfare of residents

brandkit_for_mvp.proposed_tagline: Digital Blueprints. Faster Reviews. Better Buildings.
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The digital blueprint management platform for Ashtabula County Building Department — streamlining plan review, reducing paper handling, and accelerating the permit process for builders and developers.

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Digital blueprint overlay on building construction scene
visual_direction.color_scheme: Municipal blue tones conveying trust and authority
visual_direction.photography_style: Professional building inspections, architectural plans, government offices

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Align with Ashtabula County Building Department's official, service-oriented mission
key_features_needed: Digital blueprint upload with version control
Annotation tools for markups and feedback
Separate workflows for residential vs non-residential
differentiators_based_on_research: Certified by Ohio Board of Building Standards
